Acquisition of Lee Hedges PLC
On 8th January 2026, the Group acquired 53.15% of the voting shares of Lee Hedges PLC, a listed company in
Colombo Stock Exchange. Lee Hedges PLC is in the business of development of property, administration and
maintenance.
The Group has elected to measure the non controlling interest in the acquiree at fair value.
Assets acquired and Liabilities assumed

18.2   Business Combination (Contd.)
During the year, the Group acquired additional shares in Lee Hedges PLC pursuant to the mandatory offer
requirements of the Company Take-Overs and Mergers Code, 1995, subsequent to obtaining control of the Lee
Hedges PLC. As the transaction did not result in a change in control, it was accounted for as an equity transaction.
Accordingly, the carrying amount of the non-controlling interests was adjusted to reflect the change in ownership
interest, with the difference between the consideration paid and the adjustment to non-controlling interests
recognized directly in equity attributable to the equity holders of the parent.
